facts.text: Full-time undergraduate and transfer students at Northwest Nazarene are required to attend chapel, with no classes scheduled during chapel times.

sources.title: FAQs for Transfers - Northwest Nazarene University
sources.quote: Yes, all full-time and some part-time transfer students are required to attend chapel. No classes conflict with chapel.
